# Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Methodological/statistical change
- [ ] Refactor or maintenance
- [ ] Release preparation

## Statistical or User-Facing Impact

Describe any effect on estimates, assumptions, diagnostics, examples, or public
APIs. If there is no user-facing impact, say so.

## Verification

List the checks you ran.

```text
# commands and results
```

## Documentation

- [ ] README updated if needed
- [ ] Help pages or roxygen updated if needed
- [ ] Vignettes updated if needed
- [ ] NEWS.md updated for user-facing changes

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and reviewable
- [ ] Relevant tests pass
- [ ] No local build artifacts, `.Rcheck` output, tarballs, or caches are committed
- [ ] The pull request follows the Code of Conduct
